description: Successful transact scenarios every ring must settle, in ring-agnostic terms: actors, funded notes, ordered steps of input slots, output slots and public legs, and the expected state after each step. rings states per ring whether the case runs, is not applicable by design, or is pending with a reason. Slots past the listed ones are padding the runner chooses for its shape. Produced by program-tests/test-utils/src/functional_vectors: cargo test -p spr-test-utils --test functional_vectors write_functional_vectors -- --ignored
